description: Read where the customer's insurance shopping stands: the stage, what the current goal still needs (by application path), a summary of the application, what Jerry found that isn't on the application yet (suggested) and, when a request is ready, the confirmation to show. It doesn't change anything. A requirement's format, when present, says how to send its answer; it's for you, not the customer. quotes.count is how many quotes jerry_get_quotes lists, and stays 0 until quotes.status is complete. Ids and tokens are for tool calls, not for the customer.

full.description: Include every typed application fact by application path, with sensitive values masked.

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool. Omit it to read the customer's most recent open intent.

name: jerry_get_status
title: Shopping status
